confirmedDesignContext: Citadel composes Azure Landing Zones, Azure-Samples Foundry Citadel layered AI governance and Sovereign Landing Zone policy overlays. The three workload subscriptions remain separate from Citadel management, connectivity and AI-governance subscriptions.

wafDecisions.decision: Citadel regional hubs, private internal ingress and Private Link for data, AI and platform dependencies.
wafDecisions.reliability: Adds DNS and private-connectivity dependencies that require monitoring and tested resolution.
wafDecisions.security: Removes public application/database exposure and centralises inspected egress.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Two regional hubs, private endpoints, firewalls and resolvers add fixed cost.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Requires central DNS ownership, endpoint inventory and policy evidence.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Keeps traffic on Azure/private networks but introduces gateway hops; benchmark p95.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Security and sovereignty are prioritised over lowest cost and simplest connectivity.

wafDecisions.decision: Container Apps interactive services plus event-driven jobs.
wafDecisions.reliability: Production uses zone support and at least two interactive replicas; jobs are idempotent.
wafDecisions.security: Internal environment and managed identities isolate components.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Elastic workers avoid permanent peak compute; minimum replicas retain interactive readiness.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: One container platform reduces service diversity, but image lifecycle and scaling need runbooks.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Separates sub-five-second interactions from up-to-thirty-minute packs.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Elastic simplicity is accepted over Kubernetes-level control; benchmark evidence sets limits.

wafDecisions.decision: Azure SQL Database Business Critical starting hypothesis for production case/control state.
wafDecisions.reliability: Zone redundancy, SQL failover groups and continuous STR/LTR backups with explicit Local or Zone backup redundancy support objectives without implicit paired-region storage.
wafDecisions.security: Entra-only, private endpoint and TDE; no public access in any environment; Geo and GeoZone backup redundancy are denied unless a later approved design proves the paired region is inside the signed boundary.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Business Critical costs more than General Purpose and may be reduced only after evidence.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Managed backup and HA reduce database operations, but requestedBackupStorageRedundancy must be inspected for every database and future-backup changes tracked.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Low-latency transactional state with indexes and connection pooling.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: In-region Local or Zone backups disable geo-restore; the explicitly approved SQL failover group carries regional recovery. SKU and Zone support remain evidence-gated.

wafDecisions.decision: Azure AI Search S1 with three production replicas as a starting hypothesis.
wafDecisions.reliability: Replica count supports query/index availability; index remains rebuildable.
wafDecisions.security: Private endpoint, Entra roles and security filters.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Three replicas are a material fixed cost for only 20 deals.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Managed indexing reduces custom retrieval infrastructure.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Hybrid/vector retrieval supports citation workflow; one partition initially.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Availability is favoured over minimum cost; load evidence may alter replicas/partitions.

wafDecisions.decision: Regional Azure OpenAI inference with no fine-tuning or autonomous tools.
wafDecisions.reliability: Provider quota and regional availability remain dependencies; analysis pauses safely on outage.
wafDecisions.security: Private endpoint, managed identity, no training use and fail-closed policy.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Token use is demand-based; prompt/caching strategy must not retain ungoverned content.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Model/version/configuration changes trigger governed suspension and evaluation.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Model and quota are selected against quality and pack benchmarks, not assumed.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Regional sovereignty and human controls can constrain model choice, quota and throughput.

wafDecisions.decision: Separate production assurance subscription and immutable verdict storage.
wafDecisions.reliability: Independent evidence remains recoverable outside workload blast radius.
wafDecisions.security: Delivery and operations cannot alter Internal Audit verdicts.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Adds subscription governance, storage and operating overhead.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Requires explicit evidence submission and assurance runbooks.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Not on interactive path; no material user latency.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Independence and integrity are prioritised over consolidation.

wafDecisions.decision: Confirmed two-region primary/recovery pattern with regional rather than Global/DataZone AI deployments.
wafDecisions.reliability: Primary zonal services plus warm recovery, SQL failover, controlled evidence replication and rebuildable search address regional failure.
wafDecisions.security: Both exact regions must be signed-approved; Citadel policy denies other locations and Global/DataZone AI.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Warm recovery, duplicate regional hubs and regional AI quota add material cost.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Requires region-specific runbooks, replication manifests and regular recovery exercises after implementation.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Primary path remains local; recovery capacity is evidence-sized and may be lower until failover.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Regional resilience is accepted with higher fixed cost, while exact deployment remains fail-closed until the approved pair is named.

wafDecisions.decision: Platform-managed encryption baseline; CMK only by explicit CISO/Legal decision.
wafDecisions.reliability: Avoids key-vault coupling for all data-plane operations.
wafDecisions.security: Encryption at rest remains enabled; CMK may add control if justified.
wafDecisions.costOptimisation: Avoids unnecessary Premium key transactions and recovery overhead beyond certificate/secrets needs.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: Reduces key rotation and lockout risk.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Operational reliability is favoured unless policy evidence requires customer key control.

wafDecisions.decision: One parameterised Bicep codebase for Citadel platform, sovereignty overlays and Stratton workload landing zones, with pinned AVM candidates.
wafDecisions.reliability: Repeatable environments and drift detection reduce configuration variance.
wafDecisions.security: Policy-as-code and no stored credentials; deployment uses human-interactive sign-in.
wafDecisions.operationalExcellence: What-if, lint and validation are planned by AFF-4/5; Phase 3 executes none.
wafDecisions.performanceEfficiency: Environment parameters tune capacity without code forks.
wafDecisions.tradeOff: Module-version governance adds upgrade work but avoids unbounded latest dependencies.

Start one partition; retain three production replicas only if availability/indexing evidence requires them.

costDrivers.control: Validate GP versus BC against RTO/RPO and latency before commitment.

costDrivers.driver: Two Citadel regional hubs, Firewall Premium, DNS Resolver, API Management and Application Gateway fixed capacity

costDrivers.driver: Container Apps minimum replicas and worker concurrency

costDrivers.driver: Storage growth, immutable retention, backups and regional copies

Allow-list telemetry fields, route audit records efficiently and set retention from approved schedules.

costDrivers.driver: Separate Citadel management and AI-governance subscriptions
